rules.name: Shadow in the Void
rules.lore: As the Hunger travel the Void Rifts, their presence instills dread into their psychically sensitive prey. Oftentimes, this is the only warning their targets have of the impending doom.
rules.text: Enemy units have -1 to all Leadership and Battle-Shock tests. Once per battle, at the start of the Battle Round, you may declare that the Shadow in the Void is in effect. When you do, all enemy units must take a Battle-Shock test.

strategems.name: Endless Reinforcements
strategems.target: One +Hunger+ +Frontline+ unit from your army that was just destroyed.
strategems.restriction: This strategem may not target a given unit more than once per battle.

strategems.name: Portable Shield Matrix
strategems.when: After an enemy Unit has resolved a Shoot action
strategems.target: A friendly +Ronnec+ unit in your army that had one or more of its models killed as a result of the attack.
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, enemy units attacking the target unit have -1 to Wound Rolls.

strategems.name: Servo Stabilization
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, your unit has +1 to its Hit Rolls.

upgrades.name: Strength of the Tribal Lord
upgrades.text: While your +Warlord+ is leading a unit, the unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

strategem.name: Black Void Totem
strategem.when: After the Activated enemy unit passes a Psychic Test for a Spell or Psychic Weapon
strategem.target: Any +Ronnec+ +Character+ model within 18" of the Activated enemy unit.
strategem.effect: The targeted +Ronnec+ +Character+ model may attempt a Deny the Psychic roll against the Activated unit, even though it is not a +Psyker+
